items.title: The question-word set
items.caption: Each word asks for a different missing piece. The two when-words split future time from past time.

items.title: The when-word and tense particle move together
items.caption: Future *ʻāfea* rides the future particle. Past *anafea* rides the past particle, and the pointing-back word holds the fronted time's place inside the verb phrase.

states.label: Future
states.sm: ʻO ʻāfea ʻoleʻā moe ai le tama?

states.label: Past
states.sm: ʻO anafea na moe ai le tama?

items.title: Choose the missing question word
items.intro: Choose the question word that completes each printed question.

data.question: What information is the speaker asking for?

prompts.why: The question asks for the person who did the action.
The how-word stands where a describing verb would stand.

prompts.sm: ʻO ___ e i ai le ofu?
prompts.why: The where-word comes to the front and *i ai* holds its place later.
The missing information is a person.
